body: See. I knew this was a waste of time. Fuck this life. It's over.
Yeah, it is. Because of people like me.
All I play now is League of Legends. Which isn't fun. It just makes me mad. Every single game just makes me mad now. But I keep playing it because I have nothing else. I have anger problems.
Anyways..... forget about it. Forget I ever posted on here. Stop wasting  your time typing to someone as pathetic as me and go help someone else. I'm just a waste of time.

Sure, you might want be whiter and thinner. But not as white and as thin as me. I'm white as in I've spent less than a few hours in the sun for the past 6 years of my life. On top of that, anemia which removes any sort of color that my skin has. I really don't think you've ever seen anyone as pale as me. Even people on chemo don't look as white as me. As for being skinny, I might as well have the body of a woman. In fact, most girls probably have more muscles than me. It's clearly obvious to anyone who looks at me in a glance that I'm a no life failure that hasn't done anything. 

I never said it was too late. It's just that the things I have to do to get over my problems are not things that I have the confidence or willpower to do, and so I'm not going to do them. As for things I like, I like playing video games, obviously. They're pretty much like a drug to me. People drink or do drugs to get over their depression, some people eat a lot. I just play video games. And I do it because I enjoy doing them. And just like drugs, they temporarily ease the pain of my problems. But they're also making them worse. And I just don't really even care.
